items.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature slowly turns to you. You hear its terrible voice directly in your head.#WHITE#*
Welcome, master.
items.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物慢慢转向你。你听到它可怕的声音直接在你脑海中响起。#WHITE#*
欢迎你，主人。

items.source: What are you, and what is this place?
items.target: 你是什么东西？这是什么地方？

items.source: Master? I am not your mas...
items.target: 主人？我不是你的主……

items.source: Why do I understand you? The texts are unreadable to me.
items.target: 为什么我能听懂你的话？那些文字我根本看不懂。

items.source: What can I do here?
items.target: 我能在这里做什么？

items.source: What else can this place do?
items.target: 这里还能做什么？

items.source: Would it be possible to improve my Cloak of Deception so I do not need to wear it to pass as a living being?
items.target: 可以升级我的欺诈斗篷，让我不必穿戴它也能伪装成活物吗？

items.source: You asked me to come, about a farportal?
items.target: 你叫我来，是为了远古传送门？

items.source: You asked me to come, about the rod of recall?
items.target: 你叫我来，是为了回归之杖？

items.source: Would it be possible for my Transmogrification Chest to automatically extract gems?
items.target: 可以让我的转化之盒自动提取宝石吗？

items.source: Are there any training facilities?
items.target: 这里是不是有一间训练室？

items.source: Can you use your magic to alter the appearance of my gear?
items.target: 你能用魔法改变我装备的外形么?

items.source: I find your appearance unsettling. Any way you can change it?
items.target: 你的样子看上去让我不舒服，你可以改变外形么？

items.source: I have come upon a strange thing indeed. #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell him about Melinda]
items.target: 我的确遇到了一件奇怪的事。 #LIGHT_GREEN#[告诉它梅琳达的事]

items.source: [leave]
items.target: [离开]

items.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You possess a control rod. You are the master.
items.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你拿着控制魔杖，你就是我的主人。

items.source: Err... ok.
items.target: 哦……好吧。

items.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master; you have the rod. I am created to speak to the master.
items.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你拥有魔杖，你就是主人，我是被制造出来和主人对话的。

items.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you with intensity. You 'see' images in your head.
You see titanic wars in an age now forgotten. You see armies of what you suppose are Sher'Tuls since they look like the shadow.
They fight with weapons, magic and other things. They fight gods. They hunt them down, killing or banishing them.
You see great fortresses like this one, flying all over the skies of Eyal - shining bastions of power glittering in the young sun.
You see the gods beaten, defeated and dead. All but one.
Then you see darkness; it seems like the shadow does not know what followed those events.

You shake your head as the vision dissipates, and your normal sight comes back slowly.
#WHITE#*
items.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物集中精神注视着你，你“看到”了脑海中的影像。
你看到了已被人遗忘的泰坦之战。你看到了一支军队，你推测它们是夏·图尔人，因为它们看起来很像那个阴影生物。
他们使用魔法、武器和其他东西战斗，他们和众神战斗，将他们击倒、杀死、驱散。
你看到巨大的类似这里的堡垒飘浮在埃亚尔的上空，在阳光之下释放出强大的能量光芒。
你看到众神都被击败、杀死，除了一个。
随后你看到了黑暗；似乎那个阴影并不知道那些事件之后发生了什么。

你摇了摇头，驱散了脑海中的影像，眼前慢慢恢复了现实的景象。
#WHITE#*

items.source: Those are Sher'Tuls? They fought the gods?!
items.target: 那是夏·图尔？他们和众神战斗？！

items.source: They had to. They forged terrible weapons of war. They won.
items.target: 他们别无选择。他们锻造了可怕的战争武器。他们胜利了。

items.source: But then where are they now if they won?
items.target: 他们是胜利了，但是现在他们又在哪里呢？

items.source: They are gone now. I cannot tell you more.
items.target: 他们已经消失，我不能告诉你更多了。

items.source: But I am the master!
items.target: 我是你的主人！

items.source: Fine.
items.target: 好吧。

items.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master. You can use this place as you desire. However, most of the energies are depleted and only some rooms are usable.
To the south you will find the storage room.
items.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人，你可以随意使用这个地方。不过，大多数这里的能量已经耗竭，只有一些房间可以使用。
在南面你可以看到储藏室。

items.source: Thanks.
items.target: 多谢。

items.source:
This Fortress is designed as a mobile base for the Godslayers - it can fly.
It is also equiped with various facilities: exploratory farportal, emergency containment field, remote storage, ...
However, the Fortress is badly damaged and has lain dormant for too long. Its energies are nearly depleted.
Take this Transmogrification Chest. It is linked by a permanent farportal to the Fortress. Any item you put inside will be sent to the power core and dismantled for energy.
There are, however, unwanted byproducts to this operation: the generation of a metal known as gold. It is of no use to the Fortress and thus will be sent back to you.
items.target:
这个堡垒是弑神者们的移动堡垒，它可以飞行。
它还装备了其他设施：探索用远古传送门、紧急防护场、远程存储……
然而，堡垒已经严重损坏，而且已经休眠了太久了。它的能量几近枯竭。
拿着这个转化之盒。它与堡垒有永久链接，所有放进去的物品都可以使用它分解，转化为堡垒的能量。
不过它还有这样一个副作用：转化物品会产生一种叫做金子的金属，它们对于要塞是没有用的，所以会变成金币返还给你。

items.source: I will, thanks.
items.target: 我知道了，谢谢。

items.source: I have already found such a chest in my travel. Will it work?
items.target: 我已经在我的旅途中找到了一个，它有发挥效用么？

items.source:
Yes, it will. I will attune it to this fortress.
Done.
items.target:
是的它会，我会把它和堡垒联系在一起。
好了。

items.source: Thanks.
items.target: 多谢。

items.source:
Long ago the Sher'tuls used farportals not only for transportation to known locations, but also to explore new parts of the world, or even other worlds.
This Fortress is equipped with an exploratory farportal, and now has enough energy to allow one teleportation. Each teleportation will take you to a random part of the universe and use 45 energy.
Beware that the return portal may not be nearby your arrival point; you will need to find it. You can use the rod of recall to try to force an emergency recall, but it has high chances of breaking the exploratory farportal forever.
You may use the farportal; however, beware - I sense a strange presence in the farportal room.
items.target:
很久以前，夏·图尔使用远古传送门不仅是为了前往已知地点，还会用它探索世界的未知区域，甚至其他世界。
这座堡垒配备了一座探索用远古传送门，现在已有足够能量进行一次传送。每次传送都会把你送往宇宙中的随机区域，并消耗 45 点能量。
注意，返回传送门可能不在抵达点附近，你需要自行寻找。紧急情况下，你可以用回归之杖强制返回，但这很可能会永久损坏探索用远古传送门。
你现在可以使用这座远古传送门；不过要小心——我感觉传送门房间里有某种异常存在。

items.source: I will check it out, thanks.
items.target: 我会去检查一下的，谢谢。

items.source:
The rod of recall you possess is not a Sher'tul artifact, but it is based on Sher'tul design.
The Fortress now has enough energy to upgrade it. It can be changed to recall you to the Fortress.
items.target:
你所拥有的回归之杖并不是夏·图尔的产物，不过是基于夏·图尔的知识而制造的。
堡垒现在有足够的能量来升级它的功能，可以使你传送时返回到堡垒来。

items.source: I like it the way it is now. Thanks anyway.
items.target: 我喜欢保持原样，不过还是谢谢了。

items.source: That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
items.target: 这很有用。好，就这么办。

items.source:
Yes master, a training facility is available to the north, but it is not yet powered on.
I will need to use 50 energy to do this.
items.target:
是的，主人。北方是有一间训练室，不过它需要能量。
	我需要至少50能量来激活它。

items.source: Maybe later.
items.target: 以后再说。

items.source:
Yes master, the Mirror of Reflections is what you need. It is currently dormant but could be re-activated.
I will need to use 10 energy to do this.
items.target:
好的主人。反射之镜能满足您的需求。它目前处于休眠状态，但可以重新激活。
它需要10点能量激活。

items.source: #{italic}##CRIMSON#This feature is purely cosmetic is available only to donators/buyers. You can unlock the room and use the preview but you will not be able to validate your choices.#{normal}#
items.target: #{italic}##CRIMSON#此功能仅限捐赠者/购买者使用。您可以解锁房间并使用预览，但无法生效您的选择。#{normal}#

items.source: That could be quite nice. Yes, please do it.
items.target: 非常好，就这么做吧。

items.source:
Ah yes, you seem to master the simple art of alchemy. I can change the chest to automatically use your power to extract a gem if the transmogrification of the gem would reward more energy.
However, I will need to use 25 energy to do this.
items.target:
嗯可以，你似乎掌握了基本的炼金术。如果转化宝石能获得更多能量，我可以让转化之盒自动使用你的力量来提取宝石，
不过这需要耗费 25 点能量值。

items.source: Maybe sometime later.
items.target: 以后再说。

items.source: I can alter the Fortress holographic projection matrix to accomodate your racial tastes. This will require 60 energy, however.
items.target: 我可以通过堡垒的全息投影矩阵来调整外观，以适应你的种族审美。这需要耗费60能量值。

items.source: Can you try for a human female appearance please?
items.target: 请你变成一个女性人类的样子吧？

items.source: Can you try for a human male appearance please?
items.target: 请你变成一个男性人类的样子吧？

items.source: Please revert to your default appearance.
items.target: 请变回原来默认的样子。

items.source: Well, you do not look so bad actually. Let it be for now.
items.target: 好吧，其实你看上去没那么糟，就保持这个样子吧。

items.source:
Yes Master. I can use 10 energy to infuse your cloak. When you take it off the effect should still persist.
However, I suggest you still carry it with you in case something manages to remove it from you.
items.target:
是的主人，我可以耗费10能量来提升斗篷，使你脱下斗篷仍能保持它的特效。
不过，我建议你还是随身携带，以备万一特效被从你身上消除时使用。

items.source: Not now.
items.target: 暂时不用。

items.source:
Demonic taint. Yes I have a way to help in the archives. However this is a long process, the subject will need to live here for a while.
She will have to spend 8 hours per day in the regeneration tank.
items.target:
恶魔的污染么，是的，档案区里有办法帮忙。不过这需要一段时间，目标生物必须在这里住上一段时间。
她每天必须在再生槽中呆上8小时。

items.source: This is great news! I will tell her at once.
items.target: 太好了！我马上告诉她。

note: Canonical pairs frozen from the tome manifest context with an explicit high --limit (the command defaults to 50 and truncates silently); the frozen count is asserted equal to the lexical t() call count for each section. Every source key was verified against the pinned engine commit, comparing the decoded source against both the raw and escaped renderings in that file. No call in this window carries args_order.
